name: woolly
description: Project memory for coding agents that flags stale lines in CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and agent memory.
long_description: Woolly gives Claude and your other coding agents one project memory that knows when it is wrong. Every fact points at the code it is about, and when that code changes, the fact is flagged instead of trusted. Woolly also checks CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and Cursor rules for lines that name code a commit removed. Memories are plain Markdown files you can read and edit, passwords and keys are refused, and nothing leaves your computer.
